method: Accelerated COMPLETE production frame, explicit dt .25 s, normal input vector, real controllers/collisions/streaming/audio/rig. Rendering only at checkpoints; not a native film or FPS test. route.clearance: source topology and access checked; local 3D support/collisions still required; no connector implied

chosen.selectionNote: Declared independent arrival on the same source itinerary before the tight residential elbow. This complete replay must still measure >=40 km, brake, park, exit and walk >=200 m. The incomplete 42km-target trial is preserved.

character.receiver: landscape only; actor receives landscape map

planet.floatingOrigin: integrated render/audio origin; canonical simulation and storage unchanged

traffic.provenance: Deterministic scenic vehicles on admitted OSM roads; no live traffic
